create_regexpool_with_strategy: create a RegexPool instance with word, pretok, or punct tokenization strategies for regex-based text cutting
compute_str_offsets: compute character-level split offsets from text using compiled regex patterns in a RegexPool
generate_levels_mask_prefill: generate a levels mask for prefill byte sequences using RegexPool get_levels_mask_prefill
generate_levels_mask_gen: generate incremental levels masks for generation step bytes using RegexPool get_levels_mask_gen
map_codepoints_to_byte_offsets: map each character in text to its cumulative UTF-8 byte offset using map_codepoint_to_byte
